function fingerFrame(f) {
  const [bx,by] = f.base, [tx,ty] = f.tip;
  const dx=tx-bx, dy=ty-by, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  const dirx=dx/len, diry=dy/len;
  const nx=-diry, ny=dirx;
  const bow = f.bow || 0;
  const cx=(bx+tx)/2 + nx*bow;
  const cy=(by+ty)/2 + ny*bow;
  return {bx,by,cx,cy,tx,ty,dirx,diry,nx,ny,len,bow};
}

function fingerPoint(fr, t) {
  const mt=1-t;
  return {
    x: mt*mt*fr.bx + 2*mt*t*fr.cx + t*t*fr.tx,
    y: mt*mt*fr.by + 2*mt*t*fr.cy + t*t*fr.ty,
    // derivative
    dx: 2*mt*(fr.cx-fr.bx) + 2*t*(fr.tx-fr.cx),
    dy: 2*mt*(fr.cy-fr.by) + 2*t*(fr.ty-fr.cy)
  };
}

function fingerHalfWidth(f, t) {
  const base = f.width/2;
  const taper = f.taper == null ? 0.16 : f.taper;
  let w = base * (1 - taper*t);
  // knuckle swell near base and mid joint
  w *= 1 + 0.055*Math.exp(-Math.pow((t-0.18)/0.07,2)) + 0.035*Math.exp(-Math.pow((t-0.56)/0.09,2));
  if (t > 0.82) {
    const u = (t-0.82)/0.18;
    w *= Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1-u*u));
  }
  return w;
}

  function fingerFrame(f) {
    const [bx, by] = f.base;
    const [tx, ty] = f.tip;
    const dx = tx - bx;
    const dy = ty - by;
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const dirx = dx / len;
    const diry = dy / len;
    const nx = -diry;
    const ny = dirx;
    const bow = f.bow || 0;
    return {
      bx, by, tx, ty, dirx, diry, nx, ny, len,
      cx: (bx + tx) / 2 + nx * bow,
      cy: (by + ty) / 2 + ny * bow
    };
  }

  function fingerPointAt(fr, t) {
    const mt = 1 - t;
    return {
      x: mt * mt * fr.bx + 2 * mt * t * fr.cx + t * t * fr.tx,
      y: mt * mt * fr.by + 2 * mt * t * fr.cy + t * t * fr.ty,
      dx: 2 * mt * (fr.cx - fr.bx) + 2 * t * (fr.tx - fr.cx),
      dy: 2 * mt * (fr.cy - fr.by) + 2 * t * (fr.ty - fr.cy)
    };
  }

  function fingerHalfWidth(f, t) {
    const taper = f.taper == null ? 0.16 : f.taper;
    let w = (f.width / 2) * (1 - taper * t);
    w *= 1 + 0.06 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((t - 0.17) / 0.075, 2));
    w *= 1 + 0.04 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((t - 0.56) / 0.09, 2));
    if (t > 0.8) {
      const u = (t - 0.8) / 0.2;
      w *= Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u));
    }
    return w;
  }

  function fingerOutline(f) {
    const fr = fingerFrame(f);
    const left = [];
    const right = [];
    const steps = 30;
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const t = i / steps;
      const p = fingerPointAt(fr, t);
      const dl = Math.hypot(p.dx, p.dy) || 1;
      const nx = -p.dy / dl;
      const ny = p.dx / dl;
      const hw = fingerHalfWidth(f, t);
      left.push({ x: p.x + nx * hw, y: p.y + ny * hw });
      right.push({ x: p.x - nx * hw, y: p.y - ny * hw });
    }
    return { fr, left, right };
  }

  function traceSmooth(points) {
    ctx.lineTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);
    for (let i = 1; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
      const mx = (points[i].x + points[i + 1].x) / 2;
      const my = (points[i].y + points[i + 1].y) / 2;
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(points[i].x, points[i].y, mx, my);
    }
    const last = points[points.length - 1];
    ctx.lineTo(last.x, last.y);
  }

  function fingerPath(f) {
    const { left, right } = fingerOutline(f);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(left[0].x, left[0].y);
    traceSmooth(left);
    traceSmooth(right.slice().reverse());
    ctx.closePath();
    return fingerFrame(f);
  }
